title: Review index retired in favor of individual issue reports
body:
This aggregate review tracker has been retired to follow the project's requested convention of one topic per issue. Its findings remain tracked in their individual reports; closing this tracker does not mean those findings have been fixed.

The original index is preserved in the local review artifacts. Synthetic production-function reproductions and relevant evidence have been copied to the individual reports so they can be assessed independently.

Administrative closure only; no implementation change is claimed.
